scope: Persisted System users, user roles, HashedString and System.VerifyPassword (phase 1)

native.toolchain: Linux MxBuild portable app and Mendix Runtime via script/oql_native_oracle

native_semantics: System.VerifyPassword ignores user name case and the Active, Blocked and WebServiceUser flags
an empty or wrong password or an unknown user gives false
the portable Runtime seeds one System.UserRole per project user role (ModelGUID is the role GUID) and creates no administrator at startup
System.User defaults: Active true, Blocked false, FailedLogins 0; specializations such as an Account are users
length of a list in a microflow expression is its item count
limitations: sign-in still uses MXRB_USERS_JSON; System.User sign-in, failed-login blocking and NanoflowCommons.SignIn are the next phase
password policy enforcement on commit is not implemented yet
